messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pre-QBR: Roadmap deviation triage and launch readiness

Team —

We have our QBR readout next Thursday; I want a tight, one-slide summary for the exec pack on product & eng readiness for the three launches we committed to for Q4. There are known deviations across the roadmap; please respond with short bullets (no more than 4) on the items below by EOD Monday so I can synthesize for the leadership memo: 

- Top 2 schedule deviations (what slipped and why)
- Current ETA and whether it's gate-blocking launch
- Mitigation in flight (owner + timeline)
- Residual risk and recommended ask from Execs (e.g., signoff on rollback, budget for temp headcount, priority swap)

Attachments: product-roadmap-v4.xlsx (latest lanes + milestones) and launch-risk-ledger.pdf. I put the NovaRetail contract milestone in the roadmap — we need a frank assessment on whether we can meet their integration date or if we should propose a buffer.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pre-QBR: Roadmap deviation triage and launch readiness

Laura — quick engineering readout: 

1) Model shard migration (INF-4821) slipped 2 weeks — root cause: dependency on new kernel rollout from runtime team + late perf regressions on 40k seq tests. ETA: 2026-11-14. Gate? Yes for Dedicated throughput targets on the new SKU.
- Mitigation: parallel canary on 2 nodes (owner: Karthik) — completing by 11/10, enables partial traffic shift and hotspot telemetry.
- Residual risk: up to 10% throughput variance under tail loads; ask: approval for 48h of burst capacity on Dedicated pool during canary (cost covered from runway).

2) Multi-tenant prefix cache eviction logic (INF-4897) delayed 1 week — root cause: GC edge-case discovered in mixed-tenant workloads. ETA: 2026-11-08. Gate? No for customer-facing launch but impacts latency SLOs under heavy mix.
- Mitigation: temporary per-tenant soft-limits until fix (owner: Hannah).
- Residual risk: higher p95 latency under 95th percentile traffic; ask: accept temporary SLO deviation for 2 weeks post-launch.

Other notes: embedding index rebuild for NovaRetail is on track (INF-4933) but requires a coordinated downtime window (1 hour).

Karthik
Director, Engineering

Laura — risk owner summary for the exec slide (bulleted):

- Risk: Kernel perf regressions on long sequences (affects Model shard migration). Impact: possible missed Dedicated SLA for new SKU. Contingency: rollback to previous kernel with degraded cost profile; Ask: exec signoff to enable rollback & temporary budget for burst GPUs.

- Risk: Cache eviction GC interfering with mixed-tenant latencies. Impact: user-facing p95 spikes under peak. Contingency: soft limits + circuit breaker per-tenant; Ask: accept 2-week exception to latency guardrail and prioritize patch in next sprint.

- Risk: Integration window with NovaRetail for embedding index (1h downtime). Impact: commercial milestone at risk. Contingency: propose 2-hour buffer window and prep comms plan. Ask: approve a 2-hr window and a dedicated CS point of contact (Emily Turner).

Also attaching the risk ledger excerpt used by Ops.

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Reliability & Ops

[Attachment: launch-risk-ledger.pdf (pdf)]

1) If Karthik's canary requires 48h of burst capacity, estimate cost delta (ballpark) and whether we can reallocate runway credits vs asking finance for an ad hoc increment. Provide a $ estimate by EOD Wednesday.

2) For NovaRetail integration: if we surface a 2-hour buffer, can we offer them a compensatory SLA credit (small, one-time) instead of rescheduling? CS to weigh trade-offs. Laura — coordinate with Emily and let me know recommended comms and credit amount.

Thanks all — consolidated notes for the exec slide below (I will paste into the pack and drop links):

- Model shard migration (INF-4821): slipped 2 weeks. Gate: yes for new SKU throughput. Mitigation: Karthik to run 2-node canary and request 48h burst capacity. Ask: approve temporary burst capacity (est. $8k) or confirm finance reallocation.

- Cache eviction GC (INF-4897): slipped 1 week. Gate: no. Mitigation: Hannah to enable per-tenant soft-limits; ask: accept 2-week latency guardrail exception.

- NovaRetail embedding rebuild (INF-4933): on track but needs a 1-hour maintenance window; Ops requests 2-hour buffer for safety. Ask: Laura to propose comms and a small one-time SLA credit (propose 5% credit for the first paid month) — Emily/Ryan, please confirm if that is acceptable or whether you prefer a reschedule.

Next steps:
- Karthik: cost estimate for 48h burst by EOD Wednesday.
- Hannah: confirm soft-limit rollout plan and rollback criteria by Tuesday COB.
- Stephanie: attach final risk ledger excerpt to slide pack.
- Laura: coordinate with Emily on comms and SLA credit; I will include recommendation for Exec approval.

Laura
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
